description: What do a recordset opened from a temporary SELECT QueryDef inside a level, and a recordset opened from the same QueryDef after the level, hold after Rollback? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). BeginTrans; qt = CreateQueryDef('', 'SELECT ID, V FROM R ORDER BY ID'); rq = qt.OpenRecordset(dbOpenDynaset); read all of rq; UPDATE R SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID = 1 (dbFailOnError); rq MoveFirst and read all; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; rq MoveFirst and read all (no requery); rq Requery and read all; rq2 = qt.OpenRecordset(dbOpenDynaset) and read all; close; read R through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
